working_directory.description: Server-side sandbox only; callers cannot override this path

camera.description: Camera for PNG export: translate_x,y,z,rot_x,y,z,dist or eye_x,y,z,center_x,y,z

scad.description: Inline SCAD source (one-shot). For multi-file designs, upload SCAD first and pass `filename` instead.

output_name.description: Optional sandbox output path (e.g. bracket.png, previews/bracket.png, renders/job1.stl). Defaults to <input-stem>.<ext> at sandbox root. Subfolders must be under resource_dirs (previews, renders, exports).

return_inline.description: Default true for PNG: embed ImageContent (base64) AND save to ~/.openscad with a ResourceLink/public URL. Set false for URL/resource_link only (no base64). For STL, operation default is false (mesh files can be large).

operations.summary: Preview SCAD as PNG (MCP chat image)
operations.description: Visual preview for MCP clients. Default: embeds ImageContent (base64 PNG) AND saves to ~/.openscad with a ResourceLink + public HTTPS preview URL (MCP_PUBLIC_URL/sandbox/openscad/…). Set return_inline=false for URL/resource_link only (no base64). Use for SEEING the design; call render_stl for printable meshes. Provide `scad` OR sandbox `filename` (from upload_file). Typical flags: imgsize (e.g. 800,600), render=true, autocenter=true, viewall=true.

operations.summary: Export SCAD as STL mesh (3D printing / CAD)
operations.description: Printable mesh export. Default (return_inline=false): saves <stem>.stl to ~/.openscad and returns filename + sandbox_uri / ResourceLink — client fetches via resources/read or download_file. Set return_inline=true to also embed the STL blob. Use for 3D model files; call render_png for chat previews. Provide `scad` OR sandbox `filename`. Re-use the same uploaded SCAD `filename` to render both PNG and STL.

operations.summary: Upload SCAD to the shared sandbox
operations.description: Store a .scad file under ~/.openscad so render_png and render_stl can both reference it via `filename` (include/use chains, shortcut workflows).

operations.summary: Download a sandbox file (PNG, STL, SCAD, …)
operations.description: Fetch a persisted artifact by sandbox-relative path (e.g. bracket.png or previews/bracket.png) without re-rendering.

operations.summary: List sandbox SCAD sources and rendered outputs
